verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one community comment that Zapier supports multiple IF conditions and THEN steps, unlike IFTTT's single condition and action. Other community users describe real gaps around conditional logic and 'escape hatches', and no first-party docs in the pack describe filters, branching paths, or merging. missing for 10: first-party documentation of conditional branching and filters, any evidence of parallel paths, any evidence of paths merging back together, hands-on corroboration.
